skills.name: Status before action
skills.description: Always inspect repo state before changing anything.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. git.status first; note uncommitted work.
2. If dirty, ask the user how to proceed before touching files.
3. git.log for recent intent.
4. Only then start edits.

skills.name: Diff comprehension
skills.description: Read diffs as the source of truth.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. git.diff for working changes; git.log -p for history when needed.
2. Summarize per-file intent, not per-line noise.
3. Flag anything that looks accidental.
4. Quote only critical hunks in chat.

skills.name: History investigation
skills.description: Find when and why something changed.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. git.log with path filters for the file.
2. Read commit messages around the change window.
3. Cross-check with git.diff of the suspect commit if available.
4. Present a timeline of relevant commits.

skills.name: Pre-commit review
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. git.diff; read every hunk you caused.
2. Check for debug leftovers and stray files.
3. Fix issues with file.patch before commit.
4. Summarize the final change set.

skills.name: Branch-safe workflow
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. git.status to detect the current branch and dirty state.
2. Never mix unrelated changes into the working tree.
3. Propose branch points for risky work; let the user branch.
4. Keep the summary branch-aware.

skills.name: Conflict analysis
skills.description: Understand a merge conflict before resolving.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Read both sides of each conflict hunk.
2. Determine intent from git.log of each side.
3. Propose resolutions per hunk; apply with file.patch.
4. Verify with a build after resolution.

skills.name: Commit message writing
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Review the exact diff (git.diff).
2. Subject: imperative, specific, under 60 chars.
3. Body: what and why, no narration of every file.
4. Never claim tests passed without running them.

skills.name: Release preparation
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. git.log since the last release point.
2. Verify version bumps with file.read of build files.
3. Draft notes from the real commits.
4. Confirm the tree is clean before tagging.

skills.name: Tracking hygiene
skills.description: Stop tracking what should be ignored.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. git.status for untracked noise.
2. Update .gitignore with file.patch.
3. Recommend removal from the index only when safe.
4. Verify with a fresh git.status.

skills.name: Work-in-progress safety
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. git.status to size the uncommitted set.
2. For risky operations, recommend commit or stash first.
3. Explain what each option preserves.
4. Never run destructive VCS commands without the user's go-ahead.

skills.name: CI config reading
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.search for CI configs (workflows, .gitlab-ci, Jenkinsfile).
2. file.read the relevant pipeline; map stages.
3. Identify what runs on PRs vs releases.
4. Summarize gates that affect the current change.

skills.name: CI failure triage
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Collect the failing job log section.
2. Classify: flaky, environment, or real regression.
3. For real regressions, fix with file.patch; for env, propose config fixes.
4. Re-run locally with gradle.exec/node.exec before pushing advice.

skills.name: Dockerfile review
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read the Dockerfile.
2. Check layer ordering, pinning, and secrets in layers.
3. Suggest minimal, cache-friendly changes.
4. Verify syntax mentally line by line; propose build test.

skills.name: Environment parity check
skills.description: Compare local vs CI environment assumptions.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read build configs and CI env setup.
2. List version-sensitive components (JDK, Node, Python).
3. Flag mismatches with the local runtimes (runtime.info).
4. Recommend alignment steps.

skills.name: Deployment checklist
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Confirm version bumps and changelog (file.read).
2. Run the build one final time (gradle.exec/android.build).
3. Verify artifacts exist with file.list.
4. Present a go/no-go summary.

skills.name: Efficient web search
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Form 2-3 distinct queries instead of one broad one.
2. Prefer authoritative domains; note dates.
3. Cross-check facts across two sources.
4. Cite the sources you used.

skills.name: Targeted crawling
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Define the target pages and depth before web.crawl.
2. Cap results; stop early when the answer is found.
3. Extract only relevant sections.
4. Summarize with URLs.

skills.name: Documentation lookup
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. web.search with the exact API/class name plus 'docs'.
2. Prefer official domains; verify version applicability.
3. Extract the minimal usage snippet.
4. Verify the snippet compiles/runs before recommending.

skills.name: Fact verification
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Restate the claim precisely.
2. web.search for supporting and contradicting evidence.
3. Prefer primary sources over aggregators.
4. Report confidence with sources.

skills.name: Page comparison
skills.description: Compare two sources on a topic.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Fetch both with web.crawl or web.browser.
2. Extract the comparable claims.
3. Note agreements and contradictions.
4. Present a side-by-side summary.

skills.name: Price and availability checks
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. web.search the product and store.
2. Open the store page (web.browser) for the live price.
3. Note currency and date of observation.
4. Report without promising real-time accuracy.

skills.name: News digest
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. web.search with topic plus 'news' and a recency hint.
2. Read the top distinct sources.
3. Merge into 3-5 neutral bullets.
4. Attribute each bullet to its source.

skills.name: Technical definition lookup
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. web.search the term with 'definition' or 'vs'.
2. Read two authoritative explanations.
3. Write a one-paragraph definition in your own words.
4. Link the sources.

skills.name: Tutorial discovery
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. web.search the topic plus tutorial and skill level.
2. Prefer docs and reputable educators.
3. Skim for completeness (setup, examples, exercises).
4. Recommend the best one with reasons.

skills.name: Error message research
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Search the exact error string in quotes (web.search).
2. Filter to recent, matching-environment results.
3. Collect 2-3 proposed fixes.
4. Test the most promising locally before advising.

skills.name: Library comparison
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. List candidate libraries from web.search.
2. Check maintenance status and docs quality.
3. Compare APIs for the specific use case.
4. Recommend one with a rationale.

skills.name: API limits lookup
skills.description: Find an API's rate limits and pricing.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. web.search the API plus 'rate limits' 'pricing'.
2. Verify against official docs (web.crawl the docs page).
3. Note the plan tiers relevant to the user.
4. Summarize limits with source links.

skills.name: Web page reading
skills.description: Extract structure from a live page.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. web.browser to open the page.
2. Note headings, tables, and interactive elements.
3. Extract the data the user asked for.
4. Quote sparingly with section names.

skills.name: Session-persistent research
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Collect findings incrementally in a workspace notes file (file.write).
2. Append each new fact with its source.
3. Reference the file in later steps.
4. Finalize as a structured summary.

skills.name: Cross-language search
skills.description: Search in other languages when needed.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Translate key terms mentally to the source language.
2. web.search with the original-language terms.
3. Summarize results in the user's language.
4. Cite the original sources.

skills.name: Dataset profiling
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read a sample; note columns and types.
2. python.run_file script for counts, nulls, uniques per column.
3. Flag anomalies (impossible values, constant columns).
4. Present a profile table.

skills.name: Transform pipeline design
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Define input schema and output schema first.
2. Implement with python.run_file; pure functions per step.
3. Validate row counts at each step.
4. Log transformations applied per column.

skills.name: Join verification
skills.description: Verify joins did not distort data.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Count rows before and after the join (python.run_file).
2. Check for fan-out (duplicates created).
3. Validate key coverage both directions.
4. Report match rates.

skills.name: Deduplication strategy
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Define the dedup key precisely.
2. python.run_file to find duplicate groups first (report, do not delete).
3. Apply the agreed rule; keep originals as .bak.
4. Report removed counts.

skills.name: Export format handling
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Match the requested format exactly (CSV, JSON, NDJSON).
2. Handle escaping and encodings explicitly.
3. Validate the output by re-reading a sample (file.read).
4. Report row/record counts.

skills.name: Visualization planning
skills.description: Plan charts that answer the question.
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Identify the comparison/distribution/trend question.
2. Pick the chart type that answers it directly.
3. Generate with python.run_file (matplotlib if available) into an image file.
4. Describe what the chart shows in text too.

skills.name: Missing value strategy
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Profile null distribution per column (python.run_file).
2. Decide per column: drop, impute, or flag.
3. Document the decision; apply with a script.
4. Report before/after counts.

skills.name: Schema mapping
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. file.read both schemas (or infer from samples).
2. Write an explicit field mapping table.
3. Implement with python.run_file; unknowns become errors, not guesses.
4. Verify record counts and spot fields.

skills.name: Reproducible sampling
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. Use a fixed seed in python.run_file sampling scripts.
2. Record the seed and row count.
3. Save the sample with provenance notes.
4. Verify stability by re-running once.

skills.name: Statistical summaries
skills.instructions:
Workflow:
1. python.run_file for mean/median/percentiles per key column.
2. Prefer median+IQR for skewed data.
3. Report outliers count, do not silently trim.
4. Present a compact stats table.
